svg.text: Low nibble of LFRQ does not change the step width (high nibble fixed to d, NFRQ=0x1f)
All five keep a 32-sample step: exactly 8 steps fit in the same 256-sample window.
Grey: captured samples, linear amplitude. Blue: carrier level of each step [dB], 0 dB = LFO value 0.
Shaded band = one step; thin gridlines = 8 samples. All panels and all three figures share the same scales.
